content:
According to 9to5Mac's web traffic analysis data, Apple is testing the iOS 27.0.1 system update for iPhone. This update is expected to focus on bug fixes and system performance improvements.

iOS 27.0.1 is coming soon

iOS 27.0.1 started appearing in 9to5Mac's analytics data a few days ago. MacRumors also has the same report.

Apple told 9to5Mac this morning that it will release a software update early next week to fix an issue where some iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models restart after Face ID recognition fails.

We reported on this earlier this week, explaining at the time that the issue occurs when users attempt to use Face ID to unlock apps such as "Passwords". After Face ID recognition fails, the iPhone may unexpectedly restart.

I personally have never been able to reproduce this issue on an iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max, but a significant number of users are clearly affected. The good news is that this is a software-fixable bug, not any kind of hardware fault.

iOS 27.0.1 is very likely (but not confirmed) to address the issue mentioned above. The update may also include fixes for other bugs affecting iOS 27 and the new iPhone 18 Pro hardware.

Since updating to iOS 27, have you encountered any issues? What about iPhone 18 Pro-specific issues? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
